blocks.html: This reference shows all the events emitted by the Medusa application related to the Customer Module. If you use the module outside the Medusa application, these events aren't emitted.

events.name: customer.created
events.description: Emitted when a customer is created.

events.name: customer.updated
events.description: Emitted when a customer is updated.

events.name: customer.deleted
events.description: Emitted when a customer is deleted.
